To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel transfer method for Bayesian optimization and show that our algorithm performs favourably in several transfer tasks.
we propose a meta learning method for transfer learning in the context of Bayesian optimization and that it is able to improve data efficiency on a wide variety of functions and tasks.
we propose a novel transfer algorithm that is able to learn structural properties from a set of related source tasks and to exploit them to improve the efficiency of the optimization process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how we can improve the performance of Bayesian optimization by learning task-specific optimizers.
the question of how to design a Bayesian optimization algorithm that can learn to adapt itself to a new task.
the question how transfer learning can improve data efficiency of Bayesian optimization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to transfer structural knowledge from a source task to a related target task and thereby improve the optimization performance.
our algorithm is capable of improving data efficiency for a variety of tasks and that the performance gain is significant for many tasks.
the proposed method is an effective and efficient way to obtain customized optimisers for Bayesian optimization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show how to use meta learning to learn a transferable acquisition function that exploits the structure of the objective function.
our method can automatically learn a customized acquisition function for a specific task, which outperforms the general acquisition function in terms of data-efficiency and robustness to noise.
we have developed a novel transfer learning algorithm for Bayesian optimization, that can automatically identify structural information from source tasks and use it to improve data efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
transfer learning is feasible in Bayesian optimization, even in a black box setting.
the proposed method provides a generic framework to transfer knowledge between related tasks in Bayesian optimization and to obtain custom optimizers for specific problems.
meta learning can be used to improve the data efficiency of Bayesian optimization algorithms.
